name: Thwake flood zone land cover before filling

columns.period: ISO 8601 interval the estimate represents (end exclusive for DW)
columns.class_value: class code in the source product
columns.class_name: class name in the source product
columns.common_class: matching Dynamic World class, to compare products
columns.area_ha: hectares inside the max extent (pixel centres inside, geodesic area)
columns.area_pct: percentage of the max-extent polygon area

sources.esa_worldcover: ESA WorldCover v200 map class (10 m)
sources.dynamic_world_mode: Dynamic World: most frequent label per pixel over the window

published_accuracy.esa_worldcover: 76.7% global overall accuracy (WorldCover 2021 v200 validation report)
published_accuracy.dynamic_world: 73.8% agreement with an expert-consensus test set (Brown et al. 2022)

uncertainty: Per common class, the min–max across the two products (different years, methods and class definitions), plus their published accuracies. Not checked on the ground.
known_issues: WorldCover is 2021, three years into construction; Dynamic World is the 2026 dry season. Differences mix real change (clearing, construction) with product differences (e.g. Dynamic World rarely labels dryland grass).
Dynamic World labels the dry sandy Thwake riverbed and the Athi channel as water; its water class here is river channel, not impounded water.
